final_series_failure_before_timeout_fix.head: ababae35131986c56ebf4cda18ef31e91967ce76
final_series_failure_before_timeout_fix.root_cause: The outer per-file timeout and the nested default-branch simulation timeout were both 120 seconds. Under host load, the outer runner terminated the test at the same boundary before the nested runner could emit its summary.
final_series_failure_before_timeout_fix.isolated_reproduction: The active file passed when run alone in the same clone, completing in approximately 85 seconds.
final_series_failure_before_timeout_fix.resolution: Use strictly layered bounded timeouts: 240 seconds for the nested canonical simulation, 270 seconds for its node:test case, and 300 seconds for the outer per-file runner, retaining the 2-second SIGTERM-to-SIGKILL escalation.

final_series_precondition_failure_before.head: 21e0d506668c0c1bea10f131aa310479e4e3c99d
final_series_precondition_failure_before.error: ENOENT while creating the first bounded capture directory below a deliberately isolated but not-yet-created TMPDIR
final_series_precondition_failure_before.root_cause: The final evidence harness supplied a fresh TMPDIR path without creating it, while the canonical runner assumed that os.tmpdir() already existed.
final_series_precondition_failure_before.resolution: The runner now creates the isolated temporary root with restrictive permissions and rejects a non-directory or symbolic-link root before creating capture files. A behavioral regression test runs the unit group with a missing isolated TMPDIR.

root_cause: The historical run cannot be conclusively attributed because its exit status, signal, per-file output, and process snapshot were not retained. An exact 21-of-37 reconstruction shows that the runner did not disappear: it completed the first three groups, then stopped by design after integration failures. In the restricted agent sandbox, synchronous child-process calls returned EPERM despite also containing status and bounded output. The identical HTTPS clone and SHA passed 37 of 37 files and 570 of 570 tests outside that restriction. This confirms a sandbox-context failure mode matching the historical boundary, but does not retroactively upgrade the incomplete historical record to conclusive evidence.
regression_test: test/harness/runner-contract.test.mjs — canonical runner publishes and behaviorally emits bounded per-file diagnostics and audits
resolution: Add opt-in bounded diagnostics, process audit, temporary-file audit, and bounded SIGTERM-to-SIGKILL timeout escalation to preserve future exit, signal, duration, child-process, active-handle, and temp cleanup evidence. Do not weaken fail-closed child-process tests or treat a retry as closure. Final closure requires three new consecutive independent HTTPS clones on one unchanged final head.
